_comment: Runtime profile (D31, D37-RUNTIME-2): all the data the engine needs about one tool; engine code holds no runtime name (D37-RUNTIME-1). A user may add or replace a profile in <user dir>/runtimes/; a project never can (D37-FLOW-8). In argv lists, {session_id}, {model} and {title} are filled in by the engine; {prompt} becomes the prompt file's text when the session starts. In path patterns, {home}, {config_dir}, {skill}, {plugin} and {name} are filled in. Checked against claude --help: -p, --session-id, --resume, --permission-mode (plan is read-only) and auth status. Not yet exercised by a real run: skill_call, session_log, limits and plugin_skill_paths. agent_paths is the agents folder of the config folder.
title: Claude Code
limits: The subscription usage endpoint gives five_hour and seven_day utilization with their reset times.
install: install Claude Code (https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/setup), then log in with: claude auth login

transcript._comment: Where a session's transcript is found by its session ID (H-090). root_env names the variable that moves the folder (account environment first, then the launch environment); root_default is used otherwise, with {home} for HOME. glob is relative to the root.

trust._comment: Pre-trust data (reuse list: pre-trust inside the project only). The engine writes these fields under a folder key only when the person has already trusted the project folder, which consent_field records under the project key. It never writes the project folder itself, and it never answers the dialog on the screen.
